headline: Catching the 'Brain' of Factory Robots… IT Services in Physical AI Competition
summary: Major domestic IT services companies are competing to secure the factory AI operating system that trains and controls multiple robots and connects them to factory equipment. They are not building robots themselves.
why: Software that coordinates industrial robots is becoming a core layer of factory automation, creating new revenue for IT services providers.
